post_mortems.title: Post mortem for Northern Rampart (court booking system)
post_mortems.passage: Include assistive technology testing in the definition of done for public journeys. Schedule a weekly cross team dependency sync with automatic escalation of blocked items. Require customer facing changes to ship behind a feature flag. Insert a privacy impact assessment gate wherever personal data processing changes. Add a recurring stakeholder demonstration to the workflow ceremonies.

methodology.title: Scaled Agile Release Train
methodology.passage: Scaled Agile Release Train. When to use it. A release train aligns several agile teams, usually four to twelve, around a shared mission, a shared cadence and a single programme backlog. It is appropriate when no single team can deliver meaningful value alone and when cross team dependencies are the dominant schedule risk.
